decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation builds on the firm's in-house laser expertise, so its R&D can interpret results and refine it, though its lower website prominence suggests a niche role.
The thermal inkjet printer sits at the core of the firm's coding portfolio, has a dedicated page in both years and is supported by in-house development, which makes it easy to assimilate feedback.
The piezo inkjet printer is close to the established inkjet know-how, has had consistent dedicated presentation and fits the firm's surface-specific technology-matching strategy.
Industrial laser marking systems are featured on the home page and build directly on the firm's established laser competence, which makes them a strategic product to develop further.
The newly launched compact laser cabin extends the firm's laser line with related knowledge and has a dedicated page, so the firm can learn from early results.
The award-winning lubricant printing system applies the firm's high-resolution inkjet knowledge to sheet metal, so its own R&D can absorb feedback from this specialised application.
